name: Lying Triceps Extension
summary: An isolation lift where the elbows bend and extend over the head or forehead while lying down, targeting all heads of the triceps.
setup: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar with a shoulder-width, palms-forward grip.
Press the bar over your chest with arms straight, then tilt it slightly back over the head.
Pin the upper arms vertical or angled slightly back.
Choose a weight you can fully control near your face; use a spotter if heavy.
execution: Lower the bar by bending only at the elbows, toward the forehead or just behind the head.
Keep upper arms still and elbows pointing to the ceiling.
Extend the elbows to press the bar back up.
Finish with a firm triceps squeeze at the top.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide: keep them narrow and pointing up.
Using momentum from the shoulders: reduce weight and move only at the elbows.
Dropping the weight near the face: lower slowly and never rush the bottom.
Wrists bending painfully: use an EZ bar or switch to dumbbells.
